description.en: Minimalist React components designed for effortless shadcn CLI integration.
description.zh: 针对 shadcn CLI 深度优化的极简主义 React 组件与微交互合集。

content.en: Sera UI is an open collection of minimalist, meticulously designed React components structured for seamless integration with shadcn CLI. Focusing on micro-motion and subtle tactile feedback, Sera UI gives developer dashboards and landing pages a polished edge.
content.zh: Sera UI 是一套强调极简克制与细腻触觉反馈的开源 React 组件集。完美贴合 shadcn CLI 注册表生态，它在按钮按下形变、菜单展开阻尼感与卡片悬浮投影上做了大量微调，让基础控件呈现出高级的设计工匠质感。
